title: Opticks: or, A Treatise of the Reflexions, Refractions, Inflexions and Colours of Light
verified_evidence: Open Library search 'Opticks Newton' returned works OL31832178W (Dover reprint, 1952) and OL19091121W (1730, printed for W. Innys). I read the OCR full text of the 1704 first printing at archive.org item bim_eighteenth-century_opticks-or-a-treatise-_newton-sir-isaac_1704, whose title page reads 'Printed for Sam. Smith and Benj. Walford, Printers to the Royal Society, at the Prince's Arms in St. Paul's Church-yard', London, and located Book I Part II (colour circle and centre-of-gravity rule).

title: The Bakerian Lecture. On the theory of light and colours
container_title: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society of London
verified_evidence: Crossref works?query.bibliographic='Young On the theory of light and colours 1802 Philosophical Transactions' returned DOI 10.1098/rstl.1802.0004, 'II. The Bakerian Lecture. On the theory of light and colours', Phil. Trans. R. Soc. Lond. 92, pp. 12-48, The Royal Society (Crossref lists no author; Thomas Young is confirmed by the Wellcome Collection catalogue 'The Bakerian lecture: on the theory of light and colours / by Thomas Young' and by Mollon 2002 Phil. Trans. A, which quotes 'Young 1802a').

title: Helmholtz's Treatise on Physiological Optics
edition: Translated by J. P. C. Southall from the third German edition
verified_evidence: Open Library search 'Treatise on Physiological Optics Helmholtz' returned work OL12361818W, 'Helmholtz's treatise on physiological optics', first published 1924 by The Optical Society of America, and OL95302W 'Handbuch der physiologischen Optik' (Voss, 1867). Web search confirmed the English version was translated by J. P. C. Southall from the third German edition (1909-1911), published 1924-25; Wade 2021 (doi 10.1080/0964704X.2021.1904182) says volume 2 treats the sensations of vision.
kind: translation of a handbook of physiology and psychophysics of vision

title: An opponent-process theory of color vision
verified_evidence: Crossref query 'Hurvich Jameson opponent' returned DOI 10.1037/h0041403, 'An opponent-process theory of color vision.', Psychological Review 64(6, Pt.1), 384-404, Nov 1957, APA. Method and context confirmed via yorku.ca/eye/huecan.htm and Shevell & Martin 2017 (PMC6022826).

title: The spectral sensitivities of the middle- and long-wavelength-sensitive cones derived from measurements in observers of known genotype
verified_evidence: Crossref query returned DOI 10.1016/s0042-6989(00)00021-3, Vision Research 40(13), 1711-1737, June 2000, Elsevier. Content confirmed via Stockman 2019 'Cone fundamentals and CIE standards' (UCL discovery eprint 10079410) and a web search of the abstract.

title: The C.I.E. colorimetric standards and their use
verified_evidence: Crossref query returned DOI 10.1088/1475-4878/33/3/301, Transactions of the Optical Society 33(3), 73-134, 1931, IOP Publishing; ADS record 1931TrOS...33...73S and a NIST citation confirm authors T. Smith and J. Guild. Standard background confirmed from Wikipedia 'CIE 1931 color space' and Stockman 2019.
kind: standards exposition by the authors of the standard

title: Visual sensitivities to color differences in daylight
container_title: Journal of the Optical Society of America
verified_evidence: Crossref query returned DOI 10.1364/josa.32.000247, Journal of the Optical Society of America 32(5), 247, May 1942, Optica Publishing Group (pages 247-274 per the Optica issue listing). Abstract details confirmed by web search; ellipse conventions confirmed on Wikipedia 'MacAdam ellipse'.

title: A Color Notation: A Measured Color System, Based on the Three Qualities Hue, Value and Chroma
verified_evidence: Open Library search 'A Color Notation Munsell' returned works OL1560367W (1905) and OL32858853W (1907, Munsell Color Co.). I read the full Project Gutenberg text (EBook 26054, archive.org item acolornotationam26054gut), whose title page reads '2nd Edition Revised & Enlarged, Geo. H. Ellis Co., Boston, 1907', copyright 1905 by A. H. Munsell.
kind: color order system and teaching manual

title: The Principles of Harmony and Contrast of Colours, and Their Applications to the Arts
edition: Third edition, translated by Charles Martel
verified_evidence: Open Library search returned works OL24976705W ('The principles of harmony and contrast of colours, and their applications to the arts', 1839) and OL20044613W. I read the OCR full text of the third English edition translated by Charles Martel (archive.org item principlesofharm1872chev, Chevreul's preface and Part I on simultaneous contrast).
kind: craft and experimental treatise on contrast

title: Interaction of Color
verified_evidence: Open Library search 'Interaction of Color Albers' returned work OL2286161W 'Interaction of Colour', Josef Albers, first published 1963, Yale University Press. Contents and history confirmed at albersfoundation.org/alberses/teaching/interaction-of-color (1963 Yale edition, 1971 pocket edition, 1972 German edition).

title: Basic Color Terms: Their Universality and Evolution
verified_evidence: Open Library search 'Basic Color Terms Berlin Kay' returned works OL64565W and OL43005024W, 'Basic Color Terms', Brent Berlin and Paul Kay, University of California Press, 1969. Contents and criticism confirmed via Wikipedia 'Basic Color Terms', Regier & Kay 2009 and Roberson, Davies & Davidoff 2000 abstracts found by web search.

title: Color Appearance Models
verified_evidence: Open Library search returned Fairchild's Color Appearance Models (works OL2691720W, 1998, and OL2691721W, 2005). The third edition (Wiley, August 2013, 472 pages, ISBN 978-1-119-96703-3) and its full table of contents were confirmed on the Wiley-VCH product page wiley-vch.de/en/areas-interest/engineering/color-appearance-models-978-1-119-96703-3.

title: Measuring Colour
verified_evidence: Open Library search 'Measuring Colour Hunt Pointer' returned works OL21460407W and OL16652145W (Wiley, 2011). The fourth edition (Wiley, September 2011, ISBN 978-1-119-97537-3) and its chapter list were confirmed on the Wiley-VCH product page wiley-vch.de/en/areas-interest/engineering/measuring-colour-978-1-119-97537-3.

title: The CIEDE2000 color-difference formula: Implementation notes, supplementary test data, and mathematical observations
verified_evidence: Crossref query returned DOI 10.1002/col.20070, Color Research & Application 30(1), 21-30, Wiley (online 2004, issue dated February 2005). I downloaded and read the full text PDF from hajim.rochester.edu/ece/sites/gsharma/papers/CIEDE2000CRNAFeb05.pdf.
kind: numerical analysis and test data for a standard formula

title: A perceptual color space for image processing
verified_evidence: Fetched bottosson.github.io/posts/oklab/ (HTML title 'A perceptual color space for image processing', published 23 Dec 2020 per the page). Follow-up facts confirmed from the Smashing Magazine interview with Ottosson (Oct 2024), the Wikipedia 'Oklab color space' search result and a Chris Lilley W3C workshop slide deck.
kind: author's technical blog post introducing Oklab

title: ColorBrewer.org: An online tool for selecting colour schemes for maps
verified_evidence: Crossref query returned DOI 10.1179/000870403235002042, The Cartographic Journal 40(1), 27-37, June 2003, Informa UK Limited. Abstract and context confirmed via a web search (Penn State Pure record) and colorbrewer2.org and Wikipedia 'ColorBrewer'.
kind: tool description from the cartographer who built the schemes
